data.title: Walmart controller sells nearly $1M in company stock By Investing.com
data.summary: In other recent news, Walmart Inc. reported strong third-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings results, with consolidated net sales reaching $186.8 billion, marking a 5.1% increase. This figure surpassed both BTIG’s estimate of $185.1 billion and the consensus of $185.5 billion. The company’s adjusted earnings per share were reported at $0.65, slightly above the consensus estimate of $0.64. Analysts have responded positively to these results, with Guggenheim, TD Cowen, and BTIG raising their price [...] raising their price targets to $140, $147, and $140, respectively, while maintaining Buy ratings. Mizuho reiterated an Outperform rating with a $135 target, noting strong performance at the start of November. Additionally, Bernstein SocGen Group reiterated an Outperform rating with a $142 price target, highlighting Walmart’s net sales growth of 4.4% in constant currency, which exceeded previous guidance. These developments underscore Walmart’s solid performance and growth potential in recent [...] The sales took place over two consecutive days at prices ranging from $129.265 to $131.933 per share. On Nov. 23, 2026, Milum sold 5,808 shares at a price of $129.265 each, totaling approximately $750,771. The following day, on Nov. 24, 2026, he disposed of an additional 1,886 shares at $131.933 per share, amounting to roughly $248,826.
